_comment: English text of the mod. Placeholders are written {like_this} and are never translated.
Archipelago item and location names are shared with the server and trackers: they stay as they are.

strings.deal.backfired: +{scrap} scrap. No one out there to take it: the pact turns on you.
strings.deal.body:
You gain {scrap} scrap the moment you sign.
In exchange, one of these is sprung:
fire, hull breach, fuel leak, system damage,
hull damage, or the rebel fleet gains ground.

Two times out of three it hits another player.
One time out of three it hits you.
You find out which only after signing.
strings.deal.closed.body: Already closed. Nothing more to gain here.
strings.deal.closed.title: Pact signed, nothing left here
strings.deal.other: +{scrap} scrap. Someone else will pay for it.

strings.deal.title: Deal: +{scrap} scrap

strings.net.error.location: The mod tried to check a location the server does not know. That is a mod defect: see FTL_HS.log.

strings.net.refused.game: That slot belongs to another game, not FTL. Check you picked your own.
strings.net.refused.items: The server refused the items handling mode. That is a fault in the mod, not in your setup.
strings.net.refused.password: Password refused. The host set one, or changed it.
strings.net.refused.slot: No slot by that name on this server. Check the spelling, capitals included.
strings.net.refused.unknown: Connection refused, with no reason given.
strings.net.refused.version: This server speaks a different protocol version. Update, or ask the host.
strings.net.slot_data_unreadable: Connected, but the seed data could not be read. Check FTL_HS.log.

strings.question.solo.title: Solo run in progress

strings.reset.failed: Cannot request a wipe: network module missing.
strings.reset.kept: Everything is kept. The mod stays offline for this session; at the next launch it will play this seed with this profile.

strings.reset.relaunch: Progress erased; a dated backup of your profile was kept. FTL is restarting on its own.
